extracted.name: Pinto Beans With Mexican-Style Seasonings
extracted.description: Pinto beans, bacon, and tomatoes with green chiles simmer with Mexican-inspired spices in this flavor-packed recipe that makes a hearty side dish or main.
ingredient_lines: 2 (10 ounce) cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers (such as RO*TEL®)
1 tablespoon chili powder, or to taste
1 tablespoon ground cumin, or to taste
1.5 teaspoons garlic powder, or to taste
instruction_lines: Place pinto beans into a large pot and pour in enough water to cover by 2 to 3 inches. Let beans soak overnight.
Drain beans, return to pot, and pour in fresh water to cover.
Add tomatoes, bacon, onion, chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 3 hours.
Check the beans occasionally and add more water if needed.
Stir cilantro and salt into beans simmer until beans are soft, about 1 more hour.
